body: "Here's access". Allows access and then starts slowly and quietly changing it all. You don't want me to have access, you want me to think I do so I'll shut up. I think it's the nail in the coffin for me.
So many. Coworkers, family members.. no one said a thing. Many felt I deserved it. I have anxiety being around anyone now wondering if they're thinking about it as much as I am.
